2609.16754.title: TAME: Token Attribution and Masking for Emergent misalignment
2609.16754.paper_summary: Fine-tuning an aligned language model on narrow, flawed data can induce harmful behavior far outside the training domain, known as emergent misalignment (EM). Prior work has localized EM in model weights, activations, and training documents, but it remains unclear which training tokens carry the relevant fine-tuning signal. We introduce TAME (Token Attribution and Masking for Emergent Misalignment), a three-stage framework: token attribution scores how strongly the fine-tuning update raises each response token's likelihood, using forward passes through a released LoRA adapter; signal characterization finds patterns among high-attribution tokens; and causal validation tests them by attribution-guided loss masking. On released EM organisms and a 6,849-example medical-advice split, attribution is concentrated (the top 5% of tokens hold 32% of the mass) and, in Llama, depleted for medical vocabulary but enriched for a register of unwarranted certainty, even after controlling for token rarity. Masking high-attribution tokens during fresh fine-tuning cuts EM by 23x in Llama and 36x in Qwen, with the perplexity cost concentrated on the targeted register rather than on medical content; an equal random mask leaves EM unchanged. In Llama, the attribution pattern suggests that EM-relevant signal lies more in how confidently flawed content is expressed than in its domain vocabulary; the causal masking effect itself holds across both model families.
2609.16754.paper_summary_zh: 微調一個對齊的語言模型在狹窄且有缺陷的數據上可能會引發遠超過訓練領域的有害行為，這被稱為新興不對齊（EM）。先前的研究已經將EM定位於模型權重、激活和訓練文檔中，但仍不清楚哪些訓練標記攜帶相關的微調信號。我們引入了TAME（新興不對齊的標記歸因和掩碼），這是一個三階段框架：標記歸因評分微調更新提高每個響應標記的可能性有多強，使用通過釋放的LoRA適配器的前向傳遞；信號特徵化在高歸因標記中尋找模式；因果驗證通過歸因引導的損失掩碼來測試它們。在釋放的EM生物體和6849個示例的醫療建議拆分中，歸因集中（前5%的標記佔32%的質量），並且在Llama中，醫療詞彙被耗竭，但對不當確定性的語域則被豐富，即使在控制標記稀有性之後。在新的微調過程中掩碼高歸因標記使得Llama的EM降低了23倍，Qwen降低了36倍，困惑度成本集中在目標語域而不是醫療內容上；隨機掩碼則使EM保持不變。在Llama中，歸因模式表明EM相關信號更多地在於有缺陷內容的表達方式的自信程度，而不是其領域詞彙；因果掩碼效應在兩個模型家族中均有效。
